title: Design System: Mohamed Aziz Ouertatani, Portfolio

display.purpose: The name in the home hero only; Archivo at 118% width. Small screens clamp(2.5rem, 9.5vw, 4rem).

headline.purpose: Page titles; 3rem rising to 3.75rem at sm (case-study title 2.25rem to 3rem).

title.purpose: Project titles in small multiples and the work index; 1.25rem rising to 1.5rem.

body.purpose: Reading text, 52 to 62ch; 1.0625rem for long-form lead prose.

caption.purpose: Figure captions opened by the figure number in medium graphite.

label.purpose: Uppercase faint head of a sub-block or table column; itself a heading, never a kicker.

figure-number.purpose: Totals, counts, metrics, step numbers and ticks in tabular lining figures.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Command palette only; nothing else on the sheet is lifted.

shadows.name: hairline-frame
shadows.purpose: Chip and screenshot frames (a drawn rule, not depth).

shadows.name: hairline-frame-strong
shadows.purpose: Secondary button frame; turns graphite on hover.

motion.name: ease-cine
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for every reveal, hover and view transition.

motion.name: bar-in
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, 900ms ease-cine, staggered
motion.purpose: Fig. 3 bars extending from the axis.

motion.name: isolate-dim
motion.purpose: Figure hover/focus isolation of a row or column.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 8px to 0, 600ms ease-cine, once
motion.purpose: Below-fold text and tables; plain 200ms fade under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The site reads as one rigorous statistical sheet in the Tufte school. Every claim is a figure, every group of projects a set of small multiples, and every mark on the page earns its ink. Cool white paper carries graphite type, hairline rules and range-frame axes; there are no cards, no panels, no fills and no shadows. Numbered figures ("Fig. 1", "Fig. 3", "Table 1") with sentence captions replace decorative section furniture.

Colour is data. Viridis is the single ordered scale, and it encodes exactly one thing: the five stages of the data-to-product path (Data, Analysis, Model, Serve, Interface). Its yellow end is held back from the scale and used for the ask alone, as a highlighter behind ink. Links take the viridis blue. Everything else is graphite on paper.

One family, Archivo, speaks in two widths: opened up on its width axis for display, normal for reading, with tabular figures wherever numbers align. Density is analytical rather than airy: margin totals, counts, ticks and labels sit close to the data they describe. The retired zellige tile wall (cobalt, plaster, saffron, chamfered tiles) and the dark neon developer portfolio are the confirmed anti-references; the scheme is light only.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper and hairline rules; no fills, panels or shadows outside the command-palette overlay.
Viridis encodes the five path stages and nothing else; the yellow end is reserved for the ask.
Range-frame figures with margin totals, one total rule, and hover isolation that dims the rest to 25%.
Small multiples on one shared label grid.
Archivo only, with width (118% stretch) as the display voice and tabular figures for numbers.
Headings stand alone, opened by a rule, with a figure-style caption beside them.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: The stage colours appear only where they encode a stage of the data-to-product path. They never decorate a heading, a button, a divider or a background.

rules.name: The Held-Back Yellow Rule
rules.body: The highlighter yellow marks the ask (and the visitor's own selection), always behind ink and never as text colour, a fill panel, or a second data value.

rules.name: The Width Is Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width, weight and size inside one family. No second typeface, no italics-as-display, no system display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that aligns with another number (totals, counts, metrics, dates, step numbers, year ticks) is set in tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading: no eyebrow, no overline, no section number label. A hairline rule opens the section and the heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Range Frame Rule
rules.body: Axes and rules extend only as far as the data. Rows are separated by whitespace; a single total rule closes a figure; a band appears only on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Isolate-and-Dim Rule
rules.body: Pointing at a row or column of a figure isolates it and dims everything else to 25% opacity over 300ms. Nothing else on the sheet uses opacity as state.

rules.name: The No Panels Rule
rules.body: No fills, panels or shadows at rest. If a group needs separating, use a hairline; if it needs emphasis, use ink weight or the highlighter.

dos: **Do** encode the five path stages, and only them, with the stage colours, in path order.
**Do** put the ask under the highlighter: graphite ink on the yellow band, never yellow text.
**Do** number figures and tables and caption them with one sentence opened by "Fig. n" in medium graphite.
**Do** close figures with one graphite total rule and carry totals in the margins.
**Do** align every comparable slot of a set of projects on one shared subgrid.
**Do** set headings in Archivo at 118% width with -0.022em tracking, and every aligned number in tabular figures.
donts: **Don't** use fills, panels, cards or shadows at rest; the command palette's overlay lift is the only shadow.
**Don't** use a stage colour as decoration, or the highlighter yellow as a data value or a fill panel.
**Don't** place a kicker, eyebrow or overline above a heading.
**Don't** add per-row rules to a figure; the band appears only on hover or focus.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or a dark scheme.
**Don't** round corners beyond 3px; round shapes are reserved for data marks.
**Don't** animate first-viewport text, or let anything spring or slide; figure marks draw in, and below-fold blocks only rise 8px once.
